items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: A couple of things for Wayne Cochran is going to be back.

ctx.x: Are you, or are you personally involved in right now? Are you working on an album yourself?
Well, I'm writing for Brown and Bryant right now. A couple of things for Wayne Cochran is going to be back. And an album for myself.
When do you envision the album that you're doing coming up?
